title: Booker T breaks through against Jarrett
summary: Booker T’s progression from tag wrestler and Television champion reaches the main event. His world-title rivalry with Jeff Jarrett supplies a new focal point during WCW’s turbulent final year.

chapters.title: Booker wins his first world championship
chapters.result: Booker defeats Jarrett for the world title.
chapters.context: After the controversial Hogan–Jarrett segment, the newly announced main event ends with Booker’s breakthrough victory.

chapters.title: Booker wins the rematch
chapters.result: Booker defeats Jarrett to retain the championship.
chapters.context: The successful defense reinforces that his first title win is the beginning of a main-event run.
